segments.dry: One reviewer with very dry skin reports the product does not moisturize sufficiently on its own as an everyday moisturizer but works well as a layering step before sunscreen and makeup.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: one says it did absolutely nothing for her skin, while another reports it keeps skin hydrated without greasiness across seasons.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer describing her skin as normal, clear, sensitive and fair developed cystic acne after a week and a half of use.

concerns.spots: One reviewer with normally clear, sensitive skin reports the worst cystic acne she has had since her teenage years after using this product; other reviewers report no breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Aside from the one report of cystic acne on normally clear skin, no other reviewer mentions new blemishes.

aspects.libelle: Layers without pilling under sunscreen or makeup
Not moisturizing enough alone for very dry skin

extraits.texte: Hyped about Korean skincare products I decided to give this a try. I have normal clear sensitive fair middle aged skin and red hair. cons; I tried this for a week and a half and had the absolute worst cystic acne on parts of my face that normally are clear. Cystic acne that I have not seen since I was a teenager. Texture reminds me of a watered down J&J baby lotion. Despite it saying peach, it smells nothing like peaches pros; the pump bottle Guess I will use the rest to moisturize my hands, knees or feet.
Early 30s with combo skin. This did absolutely nothing for my skin. Texture is like watered down lotion, yes i know it states that this is a milky lotion. Will be using on my body just to use it up.

I have very dry skin, and this is a game changer for skin prep before makeup. I first use a milky toner and then I layer this conditioning milk on top before ending with sunscreen. I use 2-3 pumps for my face, and it does not pill. I do let it dry for 10 minutes before applying makeup. This is a VERY lightweight moisturizer. It will not work for dry skin on its own for an everyday moisturizer. That is not what it is for. This is for additional moisturizing needed.

I have combo skin and I also live in New England where the winters are harsh and the Summers are hot!!! I find that this works year round through any season. Its kept my skin hydrated without being greasy and kept it glowing without being oily. Its so good.
i like it! definitely a lotion and not a moisturizer ~ not moisturizing but still feels nice under moistuizer. good alternative to a niacinamide serum

it's a bit thicker than the ilia milk mosturizer, super mosturizing. works as a final skincare step or layering with another mosturizer. is a decent primer for makeup too, and it doesn't pill with my sunscreen or makeup!

reserve: Only eight reviews are available and most do not specify a skin type or concern in detail, so conclusions for several segments and concerns rest on a single testimony.
